learnings: API errors should trigger automatic retry or fallback to another model rather than marking the entire audit as inconclusive
Model response parsing should be more robust to handle unexpected formats (e.g., content safety filters returning non-standard responses)
When infrastructure errors prevent file review, the tool should distinguish between 'could not review due to error' and 'reviewed and found safe' to avoid false inconclusive verdicts
Advisory reports with parsing errors should be clearly flagged as tool failures rather than security concerns
